svg.title: Learning, drawn as the tree of life upside down
svg.desc: A tree growing downward from a single first question. Every branch a learner took is kept: arrivals are marked with a dot, dead ends are kept and marked with a cross rather than pruned. A dashed arc joins two distant branches where one learner's question answers another's. A hatched region holds faint ghost branches: the negative space, the parts of the subject nobody has explored yet.
